subarea.label: Documents, Evidence and Compliance Records
subarea.description: Documents and evidence supporting identity, rights, compliance, transactions and technical facts.

applicable_certificate.definition: Certification information about a product, organization, service, place, or person.

associated_media.definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for encoding.

certification_status.definition: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also  [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

citation.definition: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

content_url.definition: Actual bytes of the media object, for example the image file or video file.

date_issued.definition: The date the ticket was issued.

encoding_format.definition:
Media type typically expressed using a MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) and [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types)), e.g. application/zip for a SoftwareApplication binary, audio/mpeg for .mp3 etc.

In cases where a [[CreativeWork]] has several media type representations, [[encoding]] can be used to indicate each [[MediaObject]] alongside particular [[encodingFormat]] information.

Unregistered or niche encoding and file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry.

is_based_on.definition: A resource from which this work is derived or from which it is a modification or adaptation.

same_as.definition: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

valid.definition: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.

candidate_concepts.source_definition: The number of levels in the property being sold (e.g., One, Two, Three or More, Multi/Split). A discreet horizontal plane of interior living space (excluding basements).
The license number of the mobile or manufactured home, also known as the Department of Housing label/insignia number. For the first or only unit/section, use License 1 over License 2 or 3.
The license number of the mobile or manufactured home, also known as the Department of Housing label/insignia number. For two units/sections, use License 1 and 2 over License 3.
The license number of the mobile or manufactured home, also known as the Department of Housing label/insignia number. For two units/sections, use License 1 and 2 over License 3.
When permitted by the broker, the options made by the individual agent on where they would like their listings syndicated (i.e., Zillow, Trulia, Realtor.com, Homes.com, etc.).

With for-sale listings, this is the date the purchase agreement was fulfilled. With lease listings, it is the date the requirements were fulfilled, such as contract and/or deposit. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.
The amount of money paid by the purchaser to the seller for the property under the agreement.
Text that serves as the negation or limitation of the rights under a warranty given by a seller to a buyer.
Indicates whether or not there are concessions included in the sales agreement (i.e., Yes, No or Call Listing Agent).
When permitted by the broker, the options made by the agent on behalf of the seller, where they would like their listings syndicated (e.g., Zillow, Trulia, Realtor.com, Homes.com).

The date the listing was placed on market. Where possible, this date is reflective of the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

The date the listing was taken off market. Where possible, this date represents the date entered by the agent, reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

The date that the listing was withdrawn from the market. This is not when a listing contract was canceled or closed, but a withdrawal from the market while the contract between the seller and listing agent is still in effect and an offer has not been accepted. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.
The total number of documents or supplements included with the listing.

The date an offer was made with a contingency. The listing remains on market. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.
The total number of documents or supplements included with the listing.
The statuses a document could be in during a transaction.

The date when the listing agreement will expire. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change contractually occurred or will occur, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS. The expiration date of listings, prior to their expiration, cancellation, sale or lease, is confidential information and should be restricted to the agent and their managers, partners or broker.
Indicates whether or not a home warranty is included in the sale of the property.

The status of the listing as it reflects the state of the contract between the listing agent and seller, or an agreement with a buyer (e.g., Active, Active Under Contract, Canceled, Closed, Expired, Pending, Withdrawn). This is a single-select field.
The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.
Special licenses required/used by the business being sold (e.g., Beer/Wine, Class H, Professional, Gambling, None).
The license of the member. Multiple licenses should be separated by a comma and space.

The date a listing, which had previously gone off market, went back to being on market. This date typically will reflect contractual dates. System timestamp should leverage the term Timestamp rather than Date in the field name.
The sum of BedroomsTotal plus other rooms that may be used as a bedroom but are not defined as a bedroom per local policy.

The date that the listing contract between the seller and listing agent was canceled. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.
Information about labor laws that are applicable to the business being sold (i.e., Union, Non-Union, Employee License Required).
The nature of the agreement between the seller and the listing agent (e.g., Exclusive Agency, Open Listing).
The original price of the property on the initial agreement between the seller and the seller's broker.
The range identified by the Public Land Survey System (PLSS).
Indicates whether or not this home requires an attended showing (i.e., Yes = licensed agent representing the seller must be present during showing).

Indicates whether or not the building offers concierge services.This includes service that provides assistance with personal business, such as making restaurant reservations, coordinating cleaning services and planning events in the community space. This is separate from the staffing in AttendanceType.
A list of the documents available for the building. Knowing what documents are available for the property is valuable information.
The name of the franchise to which the broker/office is contracted.
A list of the documents available for the property. Knowing what documents are available for the property is valuable information.
A simplified version of days on market (DOM) where the calculation is a simple start and end, such as the difference between the listing input or contract date and the date of sale.
Indicates whether or not the property owner has grazing permits from the Bureau of Land Management.

The effective date of the agreement between the seller and the seller's broker. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.
The total number of units currently under a lease agreement.
The section identified by the Public Land Survey System (PLSS).
Any other annual taxes, not including the tax reported in the TaxAmount field, as of the last assessment made by the taxing authority.
The license type of the member.
An independent license number is issued when an office/firm is a corporation.
The license number for the auction in which the property is available.

The year that an occupancy permit was first granted for the building or some other local measure of initial habitability. An empty value is permitted with an attribute noting that it is an unknown date or that the building is new construction. The year that an occupancy permit is first granted for the house or other local measure of initial habitability of the build.
